Results.ReviewText:
This grill was a gift at Christmas.  It took me about 2.5 hours to assemble, but it was actually easy considering how many parts there are.  And I take time to read directions and double check drawings etc.  I didn't have to redo anything.  The grill is sturdier than any grill I have owned before (I have has several). I love the starter button which makes lighting it so easy. The cooking grates are so good, the meat doesn't stick to them and the brushes Weber sells are perfect for cleaning the grates. 
Suggestions: Before you ever use the grill, buy the correct cover and use it whenever the grill isn't in use.  But, do wait until it cools to put the cover on.  Clean the outside after every use with stainless cleaner and a cloth.  Change out the little drip pan after every two or three grillings.  They are a little small and if they overflow you will have a mess. Finally, this grill can get hot! I only turn it all the way up except to clean it after use.  If you set it on the bottom setting it will keep the grill at 350 - 400 with the lid closed. Nothing should probably ever be cooked hotter than that, except searing a steak. 
Aside from buying the brushes and cover, go ahead and buy a smoker box.  At least in Texas we know the difference between grilling and BBQ. And if you want to BBQ, you can't do that without smoke.  With a smoker box (Weber sells one), you can soak some hickory, oak or mesquite wood chips, put them in the smoker box and set if on the back of the grill.  Then is you smoke (BBQ) a brisket or chicken for fajita meat, it will have good smoke flavor (not as good as a wood fired pit, but this is close enough and not nearly as difficult). 
FYI - please don't call grilling hotdogs on the grill Barbeque!  It is just grilling!
Results.Title: Excellent Grill - Easy to assemble, easy to use

Results.ReviewText: We decided to go smaller. Still wonder if we should have gone with the one size up. We did get the Griddle, Smoker Box, Utensils, Thermometer, smoker chips, Weber Gloves. Maybe the Grill lights to add later. Also Weber non-stick spray, a vast improvement over the big brand sprays in the supermarkets etc. Also got the Weber grill cover. So nice how well the propane ingniter works! The Griddle is the best feature. Bacon comes out flat like diners and good restaurants provide. Have not gotten accustomed to the fuel gauge deal. Also, got the wooden handle and metal grill brushes from Weber, very sturdy and performs well. We got the Red grill cover just to be different :-)

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
